text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer's rival for the Satsuki Sho is Mejiro Ryan. However, Ryan doesn't see her as a threat. To the contrary, she says Palmer's presence sets her at ease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Palmer runs away from her position as the family mediator and aims to be the person she truly wants to be.
